title: Literally Every Job Is at Risk. Here's How to Protect Yourself
description:
First they told you learn to code. Then AI learned to code. So they told you to learn a trade, because a chatbot can't fix a toilet. But the godfather of AI finished that sentence: be a plumber until the humanoid robots show up. And they are showing up. About 13,000 humanoids shipped in 2025, and one of them held a job at a BMW factory for 11 months.

In this video I go through it piece by piece. The brain went first: companies blamed AI for more than 120,000 announced job cuts in the first nine months of 2026, and it's hitting entry-level workers first. Then it got a body. I break down which robots are deployed, which are claimed and which are coming, and why a house built for human hands is built for a humanoid too. Then I go job by job, from cashiers and truck drivers to plumbers, programmers, radiologists and brain surgeons.

Then I get into what all this does to the economy, who holds the cards once your labor stops being your leverage, and how I think you protect yourself while you still have a paycheck.
